7349.title: Browser CLI loses session recovery guidance
7349.rootCauseOneLine: The CLI error matcher omits host expiry and worker-loss messages and process cancellation, falling through to command_failed without recovery hints.
7349.proposedFix: Extend existing CLI session-failure classification and its boundary test table; give cancellation/timeout the reopen hint and existing timeout ceiling.
7349.caveats: Producer errors were injected at the CLI boundary, not triggered by a live browser. The same investigator reproduced all three failures in two clean checkouts.
